title: Kuaibo case · Platform operations and regulatory action

sources.name: First-instance judgment in this case
sources.quote: As the builder, manager and operator of the Kuaibo network system, Kuaibo was obliged by law to bear network security management duties.

sources.name: Administrative warning by Shenzhen cyber police

loc.file: administrative penalty recorded in the judgment

sources.quote: In August 2012 the Public Information Network Security Supervision Sub-bureau of the Shenzhen Public Security Bureau inspected Kuaibo and, for failing to establish a security protection management system and failing to implement security protection technical measures, issued an administrative warning and ordered rectification.

sources.name: Administrative penalty decision, Nanshan broadcasting authority

loc.file: administrative penalty recorded in the judgment

sources.quote: On 11 October 2013 the Nanshan broadcasting authority found that Kuaibo was providing internet audio-visual programme services without authorisation and that its programmes contained content inducing minors to offend and depicting violence, pornography, gambling and terror, and imposed an administrative penalty.

sources.name: Cooperation agreement between Kuaibo and Guangtong
sources.quote: Guangtong supplied the hardware, namely four servers; Kuaibo supplied the content data source and the data transmission solution that reduced outbound bandwidth and improved user experience, and maintained the software system and its content remotely.

sources.name: Expert opinion on the four servers at issue
sources.quote: The public security authority extracted 29,841 video files from the servers for examination and found 21,251 of them to be obscene.

events.label: Shenzhen Kuaibo Technology Co., Ltd. is incorporated
events.detail: The company was a limited liability company operating the Kuaibo website (www.kuaibo.com and others). It held an online culture business licence but had not obtained an internet audio-visual programme service licence by the date of the offence.

events.label: Shenzhen cyber police inspect and issue a warning
events.detail: After inspection the Public Information Network Security Supervision Sub-bureau of the Shenzhen Public Security Bureau issued an administrative warning and ordered rectification, then sent Kuaibo the unlawful keywords and links to unlawful video sites, requiring it to filter and block them.

events.label: Kuaibo launches the "110" harmful-information platform
events.detail: Kuaibo set up an information security team for the push and put the "110" harmful-information management platform into use on 8 August.

events.label: Kuaibo reports 15,836 items of harmful information
events.summary: once accepted, the platform is left idle
events.detail: By 26 September it had reported 15,836 items of harmful information in the "pornography filter" category; after Shenzhen cyber police accepted the work, the security team's original four members either resigned or transferred, and work on the "110" platform was essentially abandoned.

events.label: Nanshan broadcasting authority finds obscene video on site
events.detail: Officers of the Nanshan District Broadcasting and Television Bureau, Shenzhen, logged into the Kuaibo website and quickly found playable obscene video through the "Super Radar" application; Niu signed on site to confirm. Kuaibo subsequently submitted only one rectification report.

events.label: Kuaibo and Guangtong bring four servers online
events.detail: Guangtong supplied four server units; Kuaibo installed the cache server system software, maintained it remotely via account and password, and was responsible for the content data source and system content.

events.label: Nanshan broadcasting authority imposes an administrative penalty
events.detail: The Nanshan broadcasting authority found that Kuaibo provided internet audio-visual programme services without authorisation and that its programmes contained content inducing minors to offend and depicting violence, pornography, gambling and terror, and imposed an administrative penalty.

events.label: Haidian cultural committee seizes the four servers at issue
events.summary: 21,251 files found to be obscene video
events.detail: The Beijing Haidian District Cultural Committee seized four servers from Guangtong during an administrative enforcement inspection; the public security authority extracted 29,841 video files for examination and found 21,251 of them obscene, over seventy per cent.

events.label: Kuaibo switches caching to fragmented storage
events.detail: To avoid legal risk from copyright and obscene video, and at Wang Xin's direction, the technical department led by Zhang Kedong changed storage from whole video files to fragmented storage across multiple servers, each server holding only 32 MB segments.
